notes.title: DeathOmen Small Update - Bug Fix
notes.content:
Hello my friends! 

Fixed a bug that caused the "I need to sleep" text to get stuck on the screen, requiring the player to close the game and reload the last save point to remove it.

notes.title: 💀DeathOmen Full Release💀
notes.content:
[h3]Hello horror fans[/h3]

[h3]We have just launched [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1842470/DeathOmen/] [b]💀DeathOmen💀[/b][/url][/b][/h3]

[previewyoutube=uML24t4qU2k;full][/previewyoutube]

DeathOmen is a short psychological horror game that challenges players to maintain their sanity over the nights in a mysterious house that hides mystery and fear. It’s a journey of constant change, full of disturbing events and jump scares.

[h3]Now you can get DeathOmen for a short period with a [u]20% discount[/u]. Don't wait then, get it now:[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1842470/DeathOmen/

If you want to get the game even cheaper, check out our bundles
https://store.steampowered.com/search/?term=deathomen+bundle

Have a great time playing,
Jeff Winner

notes.title: DeathOmen Final Release Date
notes.content:
[h3]Hello horror fans[/h3]

[h3]My upcoming scary horror I was working a lot lately[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1842470/DeathOmen/] [b]😱DeathOmen😱[/b][/url][/b][/h3] is coming as a [h3][b]full release on 5th of February![/b][/h3]

[previewyoutube=uML24t4qU2k;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]DeathOmen[/b] is a psychological horror game that challenges players to maintain their sanity over several nights in a mysterious location where every choice leads to unrelenting mystery and fear. It’s a journey of constant change, full of disturbing events and jump scares.

[h3]I was working hard day and night to make the game as best as I could, if you like what you see, consider adding the game to your [u]wishlist[/u][/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1842470/DeathOmen/

Have a great time playing,
Jeff Winner

Have a great time playing,

notes.title: DeathOmen Trailer and Release Date!
notes.content:
Hello there!

I am Jeff Winner, creator of [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3209910/Slender_Reborn/]Slender Reborn[/url][/b] and [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1842470/DeathOmen/]DeathOmen[/url][/b].

And I'm coming here on the last day of 2023 to tell you that I restarted my project after a long period of depression.

[h3][b]DeathOmen[/b] is coming out in [u]January 202[/u]5[/h3]

The idea is the same, I changed a few things, and the game will be low-priced, under $10, something [b]around $6.99 and $7.99[/b].

Here is the new trailer: [previewyoutube=inkJS_QWgSM;full][/previewyoutube]


Please [u]share this news[/u] with your friends and [u][b]wishlist the game[/b][/u] now if you still haven't:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1842470/DeathOmen/

[u][b]Happy New Year![/b][/u]
